name: Linear
description: Linear project management integration for OpenClaw

apiKey.description: Linear API key for authentication (create at linear.app/settings/account/security). Used for single-workspace mode.

webhookSecret.description: Webhook signing secret for HMAC verification. Used for single-workspace mode.

teamIds.description: Linear team keys to listen for (e.g. ["ENG", "OPS"]). Empty = all teams. Used for single-workspace mode.

eventFilter.description: Event types to handle (e.g. ["Issue", "Comment"]). Empty = all types. Used for single-workspace mode.

agentMapping.description: Map Linear user IDs to OpenClaw agent IDs for routing (e.g. {"linear-user-uuid": "agent-name"}). Used for single-workspace mode.

debounceMs.description: Debounce window in milliseconds for batching webhook events before dispatch (default: 30000)

stateActions.description: Map Linear state types or names to queue actions. Keys can be state types (triage, backlog, unstarted, started, completed, canceled) or state names (e.g. "In Review", "Todo"). Name matches take precedence over type matches (case-insensitive). Actions: add (re-add to queue), remove (remove from queue), ignore (do nothing). Defaults: backlog/unstarted=add, completed/canceled=remove, others=ignore. Used for single-workspace mode.

workspaces.description: Array of workspace configurations for multi-workspace mode. When present, apiKey/webhookSecret at the top level are ignored.

apiKey.description: Linear API key for this workspace

webhookSecret.description: Webhook signing secret for this workspace

teamIds.description: Linear team keys to listen for (e.g. ["ENG", "OPS"]). Empty = all teams.

eventFilter.description: Event types to handle (e.g. ["Issue", "Comment"]). Empty = all types.

agentMapping.description: Map Linear user IDs to OpenClaw agent IDs for routing

stateActions.description: Map Linear state types or names to queue actions
